shortDescription.default: Manage Intercompany Work Authorizations, modifications, approvals, resources, and funding.

longDescription.default: A full-lifecycle application for creating, reviewing, approving, and managing Intercompany Work Authorizations (IWAs) and modifications. Includes workflow routing, resource and labor planning, travel and ODC tracking, funding summaries, dashboards, exports, and administrative configuration.
